name: com.drivebuddyapp.drivebuddysdk.DriveBuddyDrivingService
description: DriveBuddy starts this foreground service to track a drive. While active, it requests activity and location updates, records motion and location events, and shows an in-drive notification.
disableEffect: DriveBuddy will stop detecting and recording drives in the background, which can break trip history or driving assessments that the app provides.
